zh: 开班和交班。JSOX POS · 班次
开店：按「开班」，输入钱箱里的零钱
en: Opening: press Open shift, enter the float in the drawer

zh: 开班后才可以收钱，每张收据都记在这一班
en: Every receipt is kept under this shift

zh: 交班：系统算好钱箱应该有多少钱
en: Closing: it works out the cash that should be in the drawer

zh: 中途放入或拿出现金，按「放入现金 / 取出现金」写原因
en: Cash in or out during the day: with a reason

zh: 输入数到的现金，马上显示短少或多出
en: Enter the cash you counted: short or over at once

zh: 交班单自动打印，老板在「报表 → 班次」看每一班
en: The shift slip prints; owners see every shift under Reports → Shifts

zh: 谁开的班、卖多少、短多少，全部记录
en: Who opened it, what was sold, what was short — all kept
